summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that its 52%-owned subsidiary, BW LPG India, agreed to sell the vessel BW Elm (2007-built) for continued trading. The sale is expected to generate a net book gain of ~US$36 million and net cash proceeds of ~US$64 million (on a 100% basis). The vessel is scheduled for delivery by mid-August. CEO Kristian Sørensen highlighted the opportunistic asset play of divesting older vessels while investing in new tonnage. This is a straightforward asset divestiture; no premium, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. Watch for delivery and cash flow impact.
